beats.summary: Andy prepares to ask out Julia but becomes nervous.

evidence.snippet: Andy: Guys, stop everything. I'm about to ask out this girl, and I'm completely panicking.
Andy: Yeah. Yeah. I mean, I've seen her, like, three times today. And we love all the same music, and whenever I walk into a room, she totally looks up.

beats.summary: Andy attempts to flirt with Julia, but she declines a kiss, revealing she just got out of a relationship.

evidence.snippet: Julia: I just got out of a relationship too. It's really hard.
